sources.title: Unlocking Data Value in Finance: A Study on Distillation and Difficulty-Aware Training
sources.audit_note: Official aggregate ablations; raw training seeds are not reported.

sources.title: Fino1: On the Transferability of Reasoning-Enhanced LLMs and Reinforcement Learning to Finance
sources.audit_note: Official aggregate ablations across four evaluation targets.

sources.title: Data-Centric Post-Training for Financial Reasoning: Mining, Distillation, and Verifiable Learning
sources.audit_note: Selected experiment chains on one fixed 778-question FINESSE-Bench subset.

sources.title: QuantEval: A Benchmark for Financial Quantitative Tasks in Large Language Models
sources.audit_note: Data-scale and GRPO progression; reasoning and knowledge outcomes remain separate panels.

sources.title: Fine-tuning Smaller Language Models for Question Answering over Financial Documents
sources.audit_note: Twenty model-target decision panels recovered. Full-target arms use more examples than the 1,500-example mixtures, so sample count remains explicit and those panels are not marked budget matched.

sources.title: Synthetic Data Generation Using Large Language Models for Financial Question Answering
sources.audit_note: Twenty panels recovered across fixed sample counts, selection by distance, synthetic-generation recipes, and real/synthetic mixture fractions.

sources.title: Fin-PRM: A Domain-Specialized Process Reward Model for Financial Reasoning in Large Language Models
sources.audit_note: Offline trajectory-selection comparison on Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct and CFLUE. The no-training control differs in training volume from the four selected 1,000-trajectory arms.

sources.title: How Much Does the Hint Matter? Scope Conditions for Hindsight Self-Distillation in Financial Reasoning
sources.audit_note: Five-seed method and ablation panels recovered. Accuracy is the decision outcome; completion rate and generated tokens remain separate cost and reliability measurements.

sources.title: A Factorial Ablation of a Speech-to-SFT Pipeline: Differential Effects on Data Quality and Downstream Transfer
sources.audit_note: Twenty-seven finance-trained model-target panels recovered from the complete 2x2 factorial table. Each SFT cell is a two-seed mean. Training-set sizes are within roughly six percent but are not treated as exactly budget matched.

sources.title: FinLCR: Scaling Financial Long-Context Reasoning via Curriculum Reinforcement Learning
sources.audit_note: Eight decision panels recovered from curriculum-component and pass-rate-threshold ablations. Aggregate short- and long-context outcomes are kept separate from six direct benchmark or split outcomes. Reported train size remains explicit, and the panels are not treated as budget matched.

sources.title: DianJin-R1: Evaluating and Enhancing Financial Reasoning in Large Language Models
sources.audit_note: Five target-level panels combine the common base, four reported SFT source mixtures, and the subsequent CFLUE-only GRPO stage. Training membership and sample counts are explicit, while stage compute is not budget matched.

sources.title: Select to Know: An Internal-External Knowledge Self-Selection Framework for Domain-Specific Question Answering
sources.audit_note: Seven finance-only Avg@5 decision panels recover training-stage, SFT-data, reasoning-sampling, and reward comparisons across three backbones. Prompting and RAG baselines are excluded.

sources.title: GRPO for Financial Advice Generation: Outperforming Commercial LLMs under CATE Evaluation
sources.audit_note: One same-backbone base-versus-GRPO panel uses the judge-independent doubly robust CATE estimate of gross-profit lift. It remains an observational off-policy outcome and is not marked budget matched.

sources.title: Constructing Synthetic Instruction Datasets for Improving Reasoning in Domain-Specific LLMs: A Case Study in the Japanese Financial Domain
sources.audit_note: Four model-target panels compare the reported synthetic-finance SFT pipeline with financial continued pretraining followed by the same SFT stage. CPT cost is not reported as a matched budget.

sources.title: Demystifying Domain-adaptive Post-training for Financial LLMs
sources.audit_note: Thirty-five target-level panels compare the same joint CPT and instruction-tuned checkpoint before and after preference alignment. Finance and general targets are retained to measure both adaptation and capability regressions. Additional appendix figures are excluded because they do not report source-native numerical tables.

sources.title: FinLMM-R1: Enhancing Financial Reasoning in LMM through Scalable Data and Reward Design
sources.audit_note: Six target-level panels compare the complete second-stage reward with one reward component removed, and one panel records the reported six-level FinData utilization curve. Reward ablations are not described as compute matched.
